slides.title: Tuesday Sports Schedule
slides.body: A packed day across soccer, college football, NHL, NBA, and MLB. Times below are ET.

slides.title: Early Soccer
slides.body: Lazio at Sassuolo starts at 1:30 PM ET on Paramount+. Two more Serie A matches at 3:45 PM ET.

slides.title: Night Kickoff
slides.body: College football begins at 7:00 PM ET with Delaware at Western Kentucky on CBSSN.

slides.title: Prime Time Ice and Hoops
slides.body: NHL and NBA take over at 7:00 PM ET. Bruins-Hurricanes on ESPN, Nets-Celtics on NBA League Pass/DAZN.

slides.title: Late Night Watch
slides.body: Kings-Spurs, Brewers-Rays, and a stack of NHL games follow at 8:00 PM ET and later.

slides.title: Follow for Daily Schedules
